answer:
Ollama uses a **4k context** by default on a GPU with 12 GiB of VRAM. The context-length docs state that the default depends on VRAM, and this tier applies: "< 24 GiB VRAM: 4k context" [ollama/docs/context-length.md].

The FAQ gives a general default of 4096 tokens, which matches this tier: "By default, Ollama uses a context window size of 4096 tokens." [ollama/docs/faq.md]

The docs also say that tasks like web search, agents, and coding tools should use at least 64000 tokens: "Tasks which require large context like web search, agents, and coding tools should be set to at least 64000 tokens." [ollama/docs/context-length.md]
